أذكار المسلم — Android

- Smaller “النص” label in the reader.
- Gentle milestone encouragement in a compact bottom sheet at 25%, 50%, and 75% progress.
- سكينة light mode and ليل dark mode, with compact counters.
- 27 offline categories and 315 original Arabic entries.
- Daily progress, reminder settings, text sharing, and square/portrait image sharing.
- APKs for Android 6 (API 23) and newer; each architecture APK is under 15 MB.

Download `app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` for most modern Android phones, or ARMv7 for older phones. The `.aab` is intended for store upload. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the downloads. The source ZIP/TAR archives are available below.

Signing: releases use the dedicated Muslim Azkar app key. Earlier development-
signed APKs cannot be updated in place; a one-time reinstall is required and
removes their local progress/settings. GitHub releases keep the same signature.
The public certificate fingerprint is recorded in `signing-certificate.sha256`
in the repository.
